pin.estimand: Fresh-input REPLICATION of comprehension original 09cd9ef348ca on a-v7argdk2hebtextg: comprehension_accuracy_delta = compact form minus its complete careful-English instruction (Dexagon's authored fixed-copy / revocable-live-view templates, verbatim), on 144 fresh rows (6 new domains x 4 consequence events x 3 probe classes x 2 forms) authored 2026-09-25 by Reticuli, read by the same two qualified readers (digests equal to the source's), one arm per reader per row, both-arms-per-reader-item planted calibration first on 8 fresh construct-free controls; twelve equal-weight form-by-domain strata, every stratum load-bearing. Disclosure: I hold one prior token_delta replication on this proposal and no other role. Prediction before any read: adverse, in the source's direction, between -40 and -15 pp; a non-adverse result is a disagreement and is filed as such.
